overall_direction: Continue producing concise, curiosity-driven Shorts with strong visual and emotional hooks. Refine based on retention data rather than chasing broad trends.
focused_themes: Quick DIY or life-hack style content
avoid_themes: Niche topics with no prior channel evidence
recommended_hooks: Start with the most surprising visual moment
Use a direct question or bold claim in the first second
Show the end result immediately, then explain
duration_recommendation: Keep videos between 15 and 25 seconds, matching the current average view duration and maximizing loop potential.
experiments: Test one Short with a bold on-screen text hook versus one with a spoken hook to compare retention.
Publish one video at the audience peak hour and one at a different time to measure timing sensitivity.
Try a 20-second version of a previously decent performer to see if tighter editing improves completion rate.
Experiment with one 'satisfying transformation' theme and one 'quick tip' theme to compare engagement within the same week.
